tasks.title: Claude Code: Vercel Python serverless API exposing the CPU application workflow
acceptance_criteria: api/index.py runs on the Vercel Python runtime (ASGI app or BaseHTTPRequestHandler) and calls the MM-APPLICATION entrypoint; no Streamlit, torch or GPU imports on this path
Endpoints: GET /api/health, POST /api/assess (single request through the full decision pipeline), POST /api/rag, GET /api/scenarios, GET /api/benchmark/latest (reads a committed CPU report)
Minimal requirements.txt (cryptography + the ASGI framework if used) and vercel.json with functions.includeFiles for model_mountain/** and examples/**; bundle stays under Vercel function size limits
Every response carries evidence_type (CPU_SYNTHETIC unless a configured live endpoint actually answered); live backend only via MODEL_MOUNTAIN_BACKEND_URL env var, fail-closed on error
Input size limits, JSON schema validation and no stack traces or secrets in error bodies; tests via the ASGI/handler test client; full CPU suite passes
`vercel dev` local run log attached as evidence

tasks.title: Antigravity: static web UI for Vercel mirroring the dashboard's key flows
acceptance_criteria: public/ (static HTML/CSS/JS, no build step required) served by Vercel; calls only same-origin /api/*
Views: overview + risk table, Live Demo (pick scenario, run unprotected vs protected, per-stage verdicts, withheld output, citations, audit JSON download), latest benchmark with n and intervals
Persistent evidence_type badge; loading, empty and error states; works at 375px mobile width and desktop; keyboard accessible with labels and sufficient contrast
Verified in a real browser against `vercel dev`; screenshots saved to docs/screenshots/vercel/

tasks.title: Codex: Vercel preview deployment and smoke test of UI + runtime
acceptance_criteria: Human has run `vercel login` and linked the project; agent runs `vercel deploy` (PREVIEW only, never --prod) from hackathon/build

Scripted smoke test (scripts/vercel_smoke.py) hits every /api endpoint and the UI on the preview URL: status codes, schema, evidence_type present, denied requests stay denied, cold-start and p95 latency recorded
Build log, function size and smoke output saved to docs/VERCEL_DEPLOY.md with the preview URL; no env secrets printed
Any failure reported to the owning agent via send_message with repro

tasks.title: Claude Code: SpartHill Devpost submission pack (not gated on GPU validation)
acceptance_criteria: DEVPOST_SUBMISSION.md answers: problem, who is affected, what it does, how AI contributes, tools and datasets, expected impact, limitations and next steps; plus AI-use disclosure (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity as build agents; IBM Granite / IBM MIA at runtime, with what was actually executed)
README top: pitch, live Vercel preview link, 5-command local quick start, architecture, results link, honest limitations
docs/DEMO_VIDEO_SCRIPT.md timed <=3:00 using the Vercel UI; docs/PRESENTATION_NOTES.md maps the pitch to Technical Execution, Innovation, Challenge Fit & Impact, Feasibility
Every claim traces to evidence produced by other tasks; GPU results stated only if MM-GPU-VALIDATION produced real evidence, otherwise listed as next step
Secret scan of the repo is clean (no Kaggle/Vercel/API tokens); human submits to Devpost
